messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "take same way with regard to food"
set: ["take same way with regard to food", "take same way each day", "take with food", "take with food at the same time each day", "may be taken with or without food but same way each time", "take with or without food", "take with food or milk to protect your stomach", "take with food or milk to lessen stomach upset", "take once daily with or without food", "take before eating food", "take with food or just after a meal", "take tablets by mouth, with or without food", "always with food or always without food", "with or without food", "take with food if the medication upsets your stomach", "check medicine label to see if should take with food or not"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
